note: Published ignore list for the clean-run (false positive) measurement. Each rule names platform noise that is not an effect of the workload. The toy agent needs none of them; they are here so the same list can be reused on other workloads, and the bench JSON reports how many events each run ignored.

rules.name: /dev/null
rules.why: discarding output is not an effect

rules.name: memfd:*
rules.why: anonymous memory, no name on disk; named so it stays visible, ignored for the clean count
